units.source_text: 十四日上午八点左右，在东亚建筑公司的工地上（横川町三十号），

en.t: At around eight o'clock on the morning of the fourteenth, at the construction site of the Toa Construction Company (30 Yokokawa-cho),

units.source_text: 正在操作的“日原组”吊车司机田代勉（二十八岁），

en.t: Tsutomu Tashiro, a twenty-eight-year-old crane operator from the Hihara Group who was at work,

units.source_text: 被坍塌的沙子压成重伤，送到附近医院抢救，

en.t: was crushed by collapsing sand and seriously injured, then taken to a nearby hospital for emergency treatment,

units.source_text: 据横川警署透露，因十米沙堆的下部挖掘过度而导致沙堆坍塌。

en.t: According to the Yokokawa police station, the ten-meter sand pile collapsed because its lower section had been excavated too deeply.
